title: Cloud Organization Recon
summary: Map an organization's public cloud footprint from domains and official pages.
objective: Starter inventory of cloud-related domains and services.
steps: Collect official domains from website, press, LinkedIn.
Identify ASN/IP ranges via public BGP sources.
Tag by provider patterns (amazonaws, azurewebsites, appspot...).
queries: site:company.com (AWS OR Azure OR GCP OR cloud)
ethics: Authorized investigations and public sources only. Do not access systems without permission.
